messages:
Eleanor (Marketing): Heads-up team — planning a "Launch Week" mini-nudge for the product newsletter. Goal: drive demo signups and quick docs reads without flooding inboxes. Draft lives here: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/launch-week-mini-nudge.

Ben (Growth): Love it. Proposal: 3-touch micro-drip over 5 days: Day 0 announcement, Day 2 feature highlight, Day 5 social proof/reminder. Keep holdback 3% for lift. Geo-stagger NA/EMEA/APAC.

Jules (Content): I compressed copy to very short bites for each touch. Subjects: "Launch Week: demo slots open" vs "See latency drops in production". Preheaders: benefit vs curiosity. Recommend testing these on the Day 0 send only.

Aiden (Ops): ESP constraints: safe burst 90k/hr. Seed test 1k tomorrow 09:00 PT. Suppression exports include global_unsub, trial_opt_outs, dedicated_customers. If hard bounces >1.2% in first 20m pause and route remainder into the scheduled drip with alternate subject.

Ben (Growth): Routing: demo_click event -> webhook /webhooks/campaigns/demo. If intent_score >= 70 tag "hot_launch_week" and push to #sdr-hot. Exclude AE-owned and enterprise-rollout accounts. UTMs: utm_campaign=launch_week_mini_nudge&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter.

Jules (Content): For the Day 2 highlight we'll include one short benchmark line and a link to a concise benchmark page. Legal approved a non-specific stat; I will use the approved phrasing.

Eleanor (Marketing): Timing: final copy by EOD today, list ready by Aiden by tonight, seed tomorrow 09:00 PT, main send window starts Thursday 10:00 PT NA. Also add a 48h re-engage for non-openers with a different subject.

Aiden (Ops): I'll set burst cap 80k/hr initially, monitors for bounces/complaints, and alert to #release-war-room. Retry policy: after pause resume at 25% velocity and ramp over 6h. Will post suppression CSV when ready.

campaign-bot: Campaign workspace updated: "launch_week_mini_nudge". Review meeting set: tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.

Ben (Growth): Action list:
- Jules: finalize 2 subject variants + 2 preheaders (EOD)
- Aiden: export suppression + run seed (today/tomorrow)
- Eleanor: approve benchmark phrasing + final CTAs (tomorrow AM)
- Ben: configure A/B test + UTMs (tomorrow AM)

Jules (Content): On it :white_check_mark:

Aiden (Ops): Will post seed metrics here after the run.

Eleanor (Marketing): Thanks all — keep replies short in this thread, ping me for urgent blocks. :rocket:
